name: je-income-tax
description: Jersey personal income tax for the 2026 year of assessment, including tax residence, the standard and marginal calculations, exemption thresholds, independent taxation and return preparation. Use for Jersey individual tax, marginal relief, child allowances, pension deductions or moving to Jersey. Covers ordinary individual assessments with source links and simplified arithmetic examples. Requires separate classification of foreign income, relief eligibility and payments already collected. Specialist residence concessions, special pension cases and a person's final assessment require further verification. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and does not establish that the Jersey pack is complete.
